items.title: Ernie Watts interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 11, 2003
items.q: He had a party at his house and Alvin Batiste—

ctx.x: Very natural. Just like you know, just like on all the records when he talked and did his introductions and all that kind of stuff, he was just sort of like that. Very open. A very
hospitable guy. And you know Cannonball is from cannibal. And if you ever hung out with him this guy could eat. He had a party at his house and Alvin Batiste—
